_A_BREADCRUMB_COMPONENT_DESCRIPTION_: ABreadcrumb shows the path to the current page in a navigation landmark with an ordered list.
_A_BREADCRUMB_BASIC_DESCRIPTION_: Parent pages use href. Items without a destination are text. The last item is always the current page: text with aria-current="page", even if it has a destination. An empty list renders nothing. separator changes the decorative separator, which is hidden from screen readers.
_A_BREADCRUMB_ROUTER_DESCRIPTION_: to accepts a path or route object and uses ALink. Only the last item is marked as the current page. label and aria-label accept translation keys and update when the language changes.
_A_BREADCRUMB_PROPS_ARIA_LABEL_: Accessible name of the navigation. Accepts a translation key; use distinct names for multiple breadcrumb navigations.
_A_BREADCRUMB_PROPS_ITEMS_: Items ordered from the root to the current page. See the item fields below.
_A_BREADCRUMB_PROPS_SEPARATOR_: Decorative separator between items. An empty string hides its text.
_A_BREADCRUMB_PROPS_HREF_: URL of a parent page. Ignored on the last item.
_A_BREADCRUMB_PROPS_ID_: Optional stable key. The item index is used when omitted.
_A_BREADCRUMB_PROPS_LABEL_: Visible text or translation key, as supported by ATranslation.
_A_BREADCRUMB_PROPS_TO_: Vue Router destination of a parent page. Takes precedence over href; ignored on the last item.
